skill.name: code-review
skill.description: Coordinates multi-agent pull request reviews with GitHub CLI commands, guideline checks, validation, and optional PR comments.
skill.summary: Runs focused pull request reviews with multi-agent checks and high-confidence findings.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick findings are mostly false positives caused by code fences and inline command names. Real risk remains where the skill instructs agents to run Bun helper scripts and GitHub CLI commands, including commands that can post PR comments. No prompt-injection text, credential exfiltration intent, or hidden network endpoint was found.

remediation.suggestion: Ensure Bun helper scripts are installed from trusted skill assets, not workspace-controlled paths. Verify script integrity before execution.
Keep terminal-only output as the default and require explicit user confirmation before posting comments to a pull request.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger static noise
remediation.suggestion: Separate slash-command examples from shell code fences when possible, and label GitHub CLI examples with their expected side effects.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests With Multi-Agent Checks
content.value_statement: Manual PR review can miss policy violations and regressions. This skill coordinates focused agents to summarize changes, validate findings, and optionally post GitHub comments.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the current pull request should be reviewed before continuing.
Discovers relevant AGENTS.md files for policy and repository guideline checks.
Uses multiple focused review agents for compliance, bugs, and logic issues.
Validates reported issues before presenting or posting them.
Can post inline GitHub comments when the user enables comment mode.
limitations: Requires GitHub CLI authentication and access to the target pull request.
Depends on bundled github-pr helper scripts and Bun being available.
Skips draft, closed, trivial, or already reviewed pull requests.
Reports only high-confidence issues and may miss subtle problems.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Run a structured review before merge and receive only validated issues with file and line references.

use_cases.title: Enforce Repository Guidelines
use_cases.description: Check changed files against applicable AGENTS.md rules and require quoted rule evidence for each violation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Comments For Reviewers
use_cases.description: Generate concise inline comments for confirmed defects when the user chooses to post review feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Run A Basic Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review for my current branch and show the review findings in the terminal.

prompt_templates.title: Post Confirmed Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review --comment and post only validated, high-confidence findings to the pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Check Guideline Compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request for AGENTS.md compliance and quote every violated rule before reporting an issue.

prompt_templates.title: Audit High-Risk Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this security-sensitive pull request. Focus on logic errors, regressions, race conditions, and risky external effects.

output_examples.input: User requests a terminal-only review of a feature pull request.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes the pull request, lists changed files, and reports validated findings with file and line references.

output_examples.input: User asks to post review comments after confirmed issues are found.
output_examples.output: The skill posts concise inline comments for unique validated issues and avoids duplicate or low-confidence feedback.

output_examples.input: User runs a review on a pull request with no confirmed issues.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that no issues were found after bug, logic, and guideline checks.

best_practices: Run the review from a clean branch with an open pull request.
Keep AGENTS.md rules specific so compliance checks have clear evidence.
Use comment mode only after reviewing the generated findings.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a replacement for human approval on critical changes.
Do not run comment mode when GitHub credentials should not write to the pull request.
Do not expect it to report style preferences that are not documented rules.

faq.question: Does this skill run local commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the agent to run GitHub CLI and Bun helper scripts for pull request analysis.

faq.question: Can it post comments to GitHub?
faq.answer: Yes. Comment posting happens only when the user runs the command with comment mode enabled.

faq.question: What does it review?
faq.answer: It reviews pull request diffs for repository guideline violations, obvious bugs, logic errors, and selected security issues.

faq.question: Does it need AGENTS.md files?
faq.answer: No. AGENTS.md files are optional, but they improve repository-specific compliance checks.

faq.question: Will it report every possible issue?
faq.answer: No. It filters for validated issues with high confidence and intentionally avoids speculative feedback.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
